summary: The customer contacted support expressing extreme frustration that their newly received router was not working despite spending three hours trying. The agent attempted to troubleshoot by asking about lights and cable connections, but the customer refused further troubleshooting and demanded a technician be sent immediately under threat of cancellation. The agent ultimately agreed to send a technician.

evidence.text: Taib taib sidi wallahi we will send a technician
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Send a technician to the customer's location.

evidence.text: Wallahi I am sorry to hear that ya akhi, please min fadlak calm down w tell me, what exact lights are blinking on il-device?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration and apologized, though telling an angry customer to calm down can sometimes escalate tension.

evidence.text: Taib taib sidi wallahi we will send a technician, bas momken check one last thing, did you enter il-username and password fi il-page?

rubric_scores.justification: The agent agreed to send a technician as demanded, but prolonged the argument by pushing further troubleshooting steps instead of gracefully handling the escalation.
